module: Registry of the routes' named back/exit handlers. A route whose back is in "handler" mode designates a name (for example garageExitHandler); router.back() fetches it via getHandler and calls it. Most handlers are defined in routeHandlers/*ExitHandlers.lua or delegate to gameplay modules (career, inventory, vehicle purchase, vehicle configuration guard).
notes: Registered handlers: firstDriveLockedHandler (first_drive_locked failure), previousRouteBackHandler (back to the previous entry with restoreLastScope, otherwise "menu"), garageExitHandler, mainmenuExitHandler, missionDetailsExitHandler, pauseExitHandler, vehicleConfigurationBackHandler, missionVehicleSelectorBackHandler, careerProfilesExitHandler, careerBranchPageBackHandler, radialBackHandler, partShoppingExitHandler, partInventoryExitHandler, vehicleShoppingExitHandler, vehicleShoppingVehicleListExitHandler, vehiclePurchaseExitHandler, negotiationExitHandler, vehicleInventoryExitHandler.

Handlers that delegate to a module (vehicleConfigurationBackHandler, part/vehicle Shopping, partInventory, vehicleInventory) are wrapper functions that resolve the module at call time; the others are read from extensions.ui_router_routeHandlers_* when the file loads.
This module exports only getHandler; the handler table is local.

getHandler.desc: Returns the handler registered under this name.

handlerName.desc: Handler name declared in the route (back.handler).

returns.desc: Handler, or nil if the name is unknown.
